payload.name: Passport Photo Size Fixer by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup passport photo resize and KB fix workflow for upload forms.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based passport photo size fixer for people blocked by ID-style crop, dimension, and file-size rules. It points to local crop, resize, and compression tools, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
